title: Orphan-Note Cleanup Finder
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=note:link
| stats sum(inbound) as inbound, sum(outbound) as outbound by note
| where inbound=0 AND outbound=0
| sort note
description: Finds notes with no links in or out — the orphans that make a knowledge base messy and hard to navigate.
value: Orphan notes are dead weight; surfacing them prompts you to connect or prune them and keep the vault tidy.
implementation: Ingest link data into `index=personal`; surface notes with zero links.
visualization: Table of orphan notes to connect or archive.
grandmaExplanation: It finds notes with no links to anything, the loose ends that clutter your knowledge base.
